projectTitle: migratory (Liquibase migrations for Spring Boot libraries)
description: migratory (org.jwcarman.migratory) discovers the Liquibase changelogs Spring Boot libraries declare in META-INF/migratory.properties and runs them in dependency order (after/before) before the application's own Liquibase, on the JVM and in GraalVM native images.
rules: A library declares its migration in src/main/resources/META-INF/migratory.properties with name, changelog (a classpath: path without a leading slash), and optional after and before.
A library depends on org.jwcarman.migratory:migratory-spring-boot-starter; an application using such libraries adds nothing.
Never edit a released changeset or move a changelog file: its path is part of each changeset's identity.
Set migratory.enabled=false to include the libraries' changelogs in the application's own changelog instead; nothing runs twice when switching.
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/migratory/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the migratory version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
